provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Pax Pamir Second Edition rules (Wehrlegig Games, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Favored suit marker next to the political suit
Shuffle the court cards into 6 facedown piles of {n} cards
One Dominance Check in each of the 4 rightmost piles
Shuffle the other event cards: 2 into the second pile from the left, 1 into each of the 4 piles to its right
Shuffle each pile separately, then stack them with the Dominance Check piles at the bottom - don't shuffle the deck
Market: 12 faceup cards in 2 rows of 6, filling column by column from the left, top row first
Each player: 11 cylinders, a loyalty dial, a player board and {n} rupees
One cylinder on 0 of the victory point track, the rest on your board
Coins and coalition blocks near the play area
From a random player clockwise, each sets their loyalty dial
Solo: shuffle the 24 AI cards; Wakhan uses a spare set of cylinders and no loyalty dial
The last player to choose loyalty takes the first turn
